title: Use card on third jail turn
description: Use card on third jail turn. Third-turn pressure makes card use better than cash fine. This scenario separates early tempo, late defense, card timing, and forced-exit pressure.

final_action.public_message: I'll use my Get Out of Jail Free card to get out.
final_action.private_thought: I have a Get Out of Jail Free card and sufficient cash. Using the card preserves cash for building houses on my orange monopoly, improving long-term rent. Rolling doubles is low probability; paying fine wastes cash. So use the card.

breakdown.message: Uses the jail card when card value beats paying cash or waiting.
